[Unit]
Description=Full 100%% service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/opt/app/bin --name "a b" --price "$$5" --pct "50%%" --q "say \"hi\"" --e "" --bs "c:\\dir\\"
WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/app
User=svc
Environment="ALPHA=va\"l\\ue 5%%"
Environment="MID="
Environment="ZED=1"
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

#!/bin/sh /etc/rc.common

USE_PROCD=1
START=95
STOP=10

start_service() {
	procd_open_instance
	procd_set_param command /bin/x 'a&b' '<tag>' 'it'\''s'
	procd_set_param env K='v&<>'
	procd_set_param respawn 3600 5 0
	procd_close_instance
}
